scope: Goal-directed TRAIN-only analysis of pinned cached128ms controls; no neural training, policy change, reserved designs or new physical case draws
inputs: Verify the existing time_varying_fit_20261007 provenance and pinned short_window_timing_20261007 inputs before processing; pin this protocol, implementation and identities in results
selection: All24 unique critical_only_oracle128ms waveforms and their clean/iid1 views; archived48 fits remain the baseline, not refitted for reassurance
physical_estimand: Instantaneous critical eigenvalue real part, distinguished from sensor-visible modal envelope growth in a varying eigenbasis
hypotheses: Carrier curvature: exact integrated physical poles with a frozen spatial vector retain the quantitative error when fitted with the existing linear-trend model
Spatial transport: moving sensor projections and biorthogonal diagonal connection account for errors absent from frozen-shape carrier controls
Mode coupling: full physical replay differs materially from diagonal-transport reconstruction despite critical-only initialization
Observation ambiguity: a good waveform fit can estimate sensor-envelope growth rather than physical eigenvalue growth; arbitrary channel drift cannot identify the latter
analysis: Reconstruct original plate matrices and continuous critical branch on the128 timestamps using CPU linear algebra. Replay ONLY the original zero-input trajectory using the identical2ms midpoint-held matrices and1ms steps; solve its two initial critical-pair coefficients against the stored physical waveform. Require raw relative RMS<=1e-7. This is independent numerical replay of cached CUDA controls, not a production CPU fallback or new trajectory dataset.
counterfactuals: Frozen initial spatial vector with exact integrated lambda(t)
Parallel-phase-aligned unit state eigenvector v(t) with exact integrated lambda(t)
Moving v(t) with diagonal connection: coefficient derivative=(lambda-w^T v_dot)*coefficient; w^T v=1; omitted off-diagonal coupling explicitly diagnostic
measurement: Same recorded noise draw and absolute noise floor; ORIGINAL measured leading51 offset/scale applied to counterfactuals to isolate transport rather than recalibrating each mechanism. Float32/cap50 retained; cap failures explicit. Counterfactuals use oracle physics and are NEVER deployable inputs.
fit: Existing unchanged waveform-only fitter, same settings and measured FFT initialization. Fit stationary warm start then linear varying model on each counterfactual; no labels passed into fitter. Reuse saved baseline physical fits.

checks.branch_continuity: Nearest-pole tracked branch must match physically least-stable transverse branch at all timestamps; record any violation, do not silently substitute
checks.physical_recovery: Keep original frequency<=5% and alpha<=max(1/s,10% abs(reference)) criteria and stationary/noisy guardrails
checks.mechanism_evidence: Require paired waveform/growth contrasts across stationary, slow and fast rates and BOTH end ratios; fitted SSE alone is not evidence. Report full denominators and explicit unresolved contributions. No novel identifiability/impossibility theorem from four designs.

decision: Select the next physically justified correction and observable acceptance checks. Iterate on evidenced corrections at progress checkpoints; a failed first correction does not abandon the goal. No unconstrained channel-amplitude drift or relaxed physical scoring.
limitations: Oracle eigenbasis counterfactuals diagnose mechanisms, not deployable performance
